description: Promote the two design docs to docs/execution with every review resolution applied, and write the build handoff doc carrying the complete cross-workstream seam register, the owner-action list and the CI warning. Resolves NIT-1 through NIT-6 and records MEDIUM-1, MEDIUM-2 and MEDIUM-3, whose subjects are all do-not-touch files and therefore seams rather than edits. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001, FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 - the handoff doc states what actually landed, including whether the provision_checkout.py edit went in or fell back. Corresponds to plan.md items 26-28.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/wix-coupons-giftcards-20261001/plan.md items 26-28 and the finding->item->test map at the end, plus the findings fields of FEAT-001, FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 for what actually landed.

Item 26: copy .agents/tasks/wix-coupons-giftcards-20261001/coupons-20261001.md to docs/execution/coupons-20261001.md and gift-cards-service-plugin-20261001.md to docs/execution/gift-cards-service-plugin-20261001.md, then apply every review resolution so the promoted copy is the current truth rather than the reviewed draft.

Item 26, the NITs: NIT-1 - replace 'Re-measured at HEAD ae1e11b5' with the date ('re-measured 2026-10-02') in both docs, rather than another commit id that will drift again. NIT-2 - correct the drifted line references: wix_ecom.py HTTPError raise is 108 (cited 106), _SIMULATED_ACTIONS is 662 (661), wix_writeback resolve/raise are 256/259 (255/258), the cart test body literal is 91 and set(body) is 160 (90/148), website_checkout's attempt_id mint is 199 (198), and razorpay-webhook's provider_paise != intent_paise is at 952 not 947 - and note that it sits on the PARTNER WALLET TOP-UP path rather than a checkout path, which matters because section 3.2 offers it as one of only two amount verifications in the tree. NIT-3 - align the wecare-gift-cards registry entry's provisioned_by with section 12.3 and adopt the renamed scripts/provision_gift_card_routes.py throughout. NIT-4 - record alongside the one-coupon-one-gift-card quotation that CreateCartRequest.coupons is maxItems 1 while giftCards is maxItems 5, so a later reader does not conclude the document misread the page; enforcing one remains correct. NIT-5 - state the no-limitPerCustomer branch in section 4.3: no COUPONUSE# condition is applied and the row is still incremented for audit. NIT-6 - prefix finding ids by revision (R2-H1, R3-H1, R4-H1) from here on, so the same label never denotes two things in one section.

Item 26, the design decisions: fold plan DECISIONS 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 and 10 into the sections they change - coupons section 2.3 (the identity block split by direction: additionalFees[] and appliedDiscounts[] asserted on the SENT payload, priceSummary.total and subtotal only on the Create Order RESPONSE, with the readOnly measurement replacing the 'unverified' note), coupons section 4.3 and gift-cards sections 3.4 / 6.3 / 6.4 (the DECISION 5 activeHold* attributes and the one-conditional-UpdateItem hold), gift-cards section 6 (the DECISION 6 customer-managed KMS key), gift-cards sections 6.5 and 7.3 (DECISION 9's paymentAttemptId on GCTXN# and the {codeHash, paymentAttemptId} pointer), and gift-cards sections 4.1 / 7.5 (DECISION 10's single redeem_cap definition, replacing section 7.5's 'payable - 100' parenthetical).

Item 26, the MEDIUMs that are documentation changes: MEDIUM-1 - state in SEAM-G13 that outcome gains verifiedCapturedPaise, written by the caller from the same razorpay_verify readback that produced outcome['providerPaymentId'], and that record_paid refuses a call carrying a provider id without an amount; add the rename fallback to section 11's table. MEDIUM-2 - add the three missing rows to the section 8.1 split table: _browser_options carries payNowPaise (reaching options['amountPaise']), _recover_ambiguous_create carries payNowPaise, and _ready_from_binding reads the binding so NEEDS NO CHANGE, stated so its absence is deliberate; extend test 112's description with options['amountPaise'] == payNowPaise. MEDIUM-3 - correct 'THREE attempt producers' to FOUR, add the blog_contribution.prepare_contribution row, and add a section 8.5 in the shape of 8.3 declaring it out of scope (a contribution flow has no Wix cart, so no wixCollectionPaise exists to cap a redemption against) with test 113b asserting it writes no gift-card attribute. MEDIUM-4 - move the Content-Type question to owner item 12.1.4 beside the alg ('while you have a real token, record the request's Content-Type') and correct the citation to say the plain/text example is the install callback. MEDIUM-5 - section 7.2 becomes five routes. MEDIUM-6 - commit_redemption's signature gains cart_id. MEDIUM-7 - the renamed tests. MEDIUM-8 - the three price fields on AdditionalFee.

Item 27: write docs/execution/coupons-giftcards-build-20261001.md, the handoff. Carry as TABLES rather than prose: every plan item with its final status; the COMPLETE seam register with each seam's id, owner, exact anchor and the test that is xfail(strict=True) against it (SEAM-C1, C1b, C1c, C2, C3, C3b, C4, C6, C7 and SEAM-G1 through G14); the MEDIUM-1 / MEDIUM-2 / MEDIUM-3 statements above; the SEAM-G7 three-part edit including WIX_GIFT_CARD_TENDER in side_effect_guard.KNOWN_EFFECTS and the record_gift_card_tender sibling (and why a sibling rather than a parameter: record_external_payment's providerTransactionId / offlinePayment:False shape describes a gateway payment and a gift card is not one); the owner-action list from both docs plus DECISION 6's KMS key creation as a pointwise confirmation; the deploy order from both docs, unrun; and the CI WARNING that .github/workflows/seo-tools-deploy.yml has a push trigger on stack matching amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/**, so the orchestrator must capture a rollback version of wecare-seo-tools before any push.

Item 28: run the full suite and audit. Confirm no pre-existing test regressed, 0 failed, 0 xpassed, and that the declared xfail count equals the DECISION 8 list exactly. Then walk design-review.json and confirm each of the 20 findings maps to at least one named test in the owned suite and appears with its resolution in a response table in one of the two promoted docs or in the handoff.
Set this FEAT's status to completed and record the final finding audit in findings.
Commit locally on branch stack with `git add docs/execution/<the three files> && git commit --only docs/execution/<the three files> -F <message file>`. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of HIGH-1..6, MEDIUM-1..8 and NIT-1..6 appears by id with its resolution in a response table in one of the three documents
No document says 'HEAD ae1e11b5'; the six NIT-2 line references are corrected; finding ids are revision-prefixed
The handoff doc names every seam with its owner, its anchor and its xfail test
The handoff doc carries the seo-tools-deploy.yml CI warning and the KMS pointwise-confirmation item
verification: git status --short  (confirm only docs/execution files and the owned paths are modified)
findings:
VERIFIED. Three documents exist: docs/execution/coupons-20261001.md (revision 4), docs/execution/gift-cards-service-plugin-20261001.md (revision 4) and docs/execution/coupons-giftcards-build-20261001.md (the handoff). Owned suite at the end: 508 passed / 7 xfailed / 0 failed / 0 xpassed across the 12 new test files plus the 3 gate files. Whole tree at the end of the build work: 6781 passed / 1 skipped / 7 xfailed / 0 failed / 0 xpassed; tests/ alone 6744 passed / 1 skipped / 7 xfailed. HEAD moved repeatedly during this step as other sessions committed.

FINAL FINDING AUDIT - ALL 20 ACCOUNTED FOR, EACH WITH ITS RESOLUTION AND ITS TEST
Measured, not asserted: every one of HIGH-1..6, MEDIUM-1..8 and NIT-1..6 appears by id with its resolution in a response table in ALL THREE documents (coupons §12.0, gift-cards §13.0, handoff §7), checked programmatically by id rather than by eye. 16 of the 20 map to at least one NAMED test that exists in the owned suite - every name in the handoff's §7 table was verified to resolve to a real `def test_...` before being written down, and one claim was corrected in the process (see below). The 4 with no test are NIT-1, NIT-2, NIT-6 and the prose half of NIT-3: all four concern what a document SAYS, not what the code DOES, and a test over prose would pin wording rather than behaviour.

THE DOCS ARE THE CURRENT TRUTH, NOT THE REVIEWED DRAFT - WHICH WAS THE POINT OF ITEM 26
Every resolution is APPLIED to the design sections, not merely appended. The six that rewrote design rather than correcting a detail: coupons §2 (DECISION 1 restated "(a) for the arithmetic, (b) for transport"), coupons §2.3 (the identity block split by DIRECTION, with the readOnly measurement replacing the "unverified" note and all three AdditionalFee price fields), coupons §4.1-§4.3 and gift-cards §6.3-§6.4 (DECISION 5's activeHold* attributes and the one-conditional-UpdateItem hold), gift-cards §6 (DECISION 6's customer-managed KMS key, with the alias indirection and the refuse-before-the-alias-resolves ordering), gift-cards §6.3/§6.5 (DECISION 9's paymentAttemptId and the {codeHash, paymentAttemptId} pointer), gift-cards §4.1/§7.5 (DECISION 10's single redeem_cap, replacing §7.5's 'payable - 100' parenthetical), gift-cards §7.2 (five routes) and gift-cards §5/§5.1 (the Content-Type rejection dropped). Both documents gained a revision-4 preamble naming what changed and why, and both now point at the handoff first.

THE SIX NIT-2 LINE REFERENCES WERE RE-MEASURED, NOT COPIED FROM THE REVIEW
wix_ecom.py HTTPError raise 108 (confirmed), cart test body literal 91 and set(body) 160 (confirmed), website_checkout attempt_id mint 199 (confirmed), razorpay-webhook provider_paise != intent_paise 952 (confirmed) AND its branch confirmed to log 'partner_wallet_topup_amount_mismatch' with stage 'wallet_topup', so the partner-wallet claim is measured rather than repeated. wix_writeback: the resolve call OPENS at 255 and its arguments including order_id are on 256, so the snippet is relabelled 256 per the review with the split noted, and the raise is at 259. _SIMULATED_ACTIONS: the review's 662 was right AT REVIEW TIME, and FEAT-003's edit has since moved it to 683 - so both documents record 662 as the historical anchor and the CURRENT anchors (:132-133, :407, :418-419, :683, :696, :821-824, :848) with an explicit instruction to re-derive.

NIT-1 WENT FURTHER THAN THE REVIEW ASKED, DELIBERATELY
The review offered "update the id, or cite the date". The date was chosen, AND no commit id is reproduced anywhere in either promoted document - verified by grep for ae1e11b5, c6fd53dc and 887466a5, all zero. Reason: the id drifted TWICE (stale before the review, stale again during the build), so carrying any id reproduces the defect. Both docs now carry the instruction to re-derive repo state, matching 00-current-owner-overrides.md's rule about dated counts.

NIT-6 SCHEME, STATED ONCE AND APPLIED MECHANICALLY
The prefix names the document revision the round produced: R4- (this round, 6/8/6), R3- (the 6/12/4 round), R2- (the first). 35 id cells in the gift-card document and 21 in the coupon document were rewritten, with the original spelling kept in brackets so an old cross-reference still resolves. The sections are renumbered §12.0/§12.1/§12.2 and §13.0/§13.1/§13.2. This matters more than it reads: R2-H3 and R3-H3 were two different findings spelled identically INSIDE ONE SECTION, so a reader following a cross-reference could land on the opposite decision.

WHAT THE HANDOFF CARRIES, AS TABLES
Plan items 1-28 with final status (all COMPLETE). Files created (34) and edited (6), each edit with the reason it had to be that file. The HIGH-5 edit in full: that it LANDED with no fallback (the git-status guard returned empty), its three parts with current anchors, why part (c) is not optional, the ConditionCheckItem aggregation it forced, the two test-support edits, the three new tests, and that --verify has NOT been run plus what to expect when it is. The COMPLETE seam register: 9 coupon rows (C1, C1b, C1c, C2, C3, C3b, C4, C6, C7) and 14 gift-card rows (G1-G14), each with owner, exact anchor and the xfail holding its place - and for the rows with NO xfail, an explicit "Pinned by" statement saying what asserts them instead, so a blank cell is never ambiguous. The MEDIUM-1 / MEDIUM-2 / MEDIUM-3 statements as their own section (§5) rather than scattered. SEAM-G7's three-part edit including WIX_GIFT_CARD_TENDER in KNOWN_EFFECTS (a frozenset validated in claim() at side_effect_guard.py:101, so the constant alone is refused) and why record_gift_card_tender is a SIBLING rather than a parameter. The xfail inventory of 7 with each one's unconditional companion, plus the FOUR tests DECISION 8 named that are deliberately unmarked and why marking them would switch off the detector. The consolidated owner-action list: 6 blocking SPI items, the KMS pointwise confirmation as its own subsection with cost/reversibility/why-it-cannot-be-deferred, 9 decisions gating first use, and 4 questions the tree cannot answer. The unrun deploy order with its four ordering constraints each given a reason. The seo-tools-deploy.yml CI warning.

THE CI WARNING WAS RE-MEASURED AND IS SHARPER THAN THE PLAN STATED
.github/workflows/seo-tools-deploy.yml lines 17-25: push trigger on stack, paths include amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/**. This build adds FIVE modules there, so a push deploys and live-invokes wecare-seo-tools. The added fact: wecare-seo-tools is one of the SEVEN functions with NO live alias, so update-function-code takes effect IMMEDIATELY - there is no publish-and-move step to pause at and no alias to move back, which is why the rollback artifact has to exist BEFORE the push rather than after.

ONE CLAIM CORRECTED WHILE WRITING THE AUDIT, RATHER THAN CARRIED FORWARD
FEAT-003 and the coupon design both referred to spec test 65 as a single test named test_all_three_new_functions_resolve_in_the_deploy_registry. No such function exists. It landed as TWO parametrised tests over the three names - test_the_new_function_is_deployable_at_all and test_the_new_function_declares_what_must_create_it_first - plus test_the_spi_function_is_not_standalone_and_ships_the_shared_tree. The second is the one that matters for NIT-3, because it asserts every .py named in provisioned_by EXISTS ON DISK, which is what makes the provision_gift_card_spi_routes.py -> provision_gift_card_routes.py rename enforced rather than merely intended. Both the coupon §7 entry and the handoff §7 row were written to the measured names.

TWO OPEN TEST ITEMS, NAMED AND SPECIFIED RATHER THAN LEFT AS A SILENT GAP (handoff §9)
1. Test 112 does not yet carry MEDIUM-2's `options["amountPaise"] == payNowPaise` clause. It stays xfail(strict=True) against SEAM-G14, so adding the clause changes nothing about the mark.
2. Test 113b (test_the_blog_contribution_path_writes_no_gift_card_attribute) does not exist, so MEDIUM-3's fourth producer is declared out of scope with nothing asserting it stays that way. The handoff specifies it exactly - which file, which six attributes, and that it MUST BE UNMARKED rather than xfail(strict=True), because the property holds today and a strict mark would xpass immediately (a hard failure under this build's own criterion) while switching off the only detector for a gift card later reaching a flow with no wixCollectionPaise to cap against. It is a gate, exactly like test 113.
Neither was written here because this FEAT's commit scope is the three documents and a test edit would have landed in a docs-only commit. MEDIUM-3's DOCUMENTATION resolution is complete (the four-producer table derived from the call sites, plus the new §8.5); what is missing is only its gate.

THE 5 LATE FAILURES ARE A CONCURRENT SESSION'S AND WERE LEFT ALONE
A whole-tree re-run after the documentation step reported 5 failed, ALL in tests/test_url_host_routing_rules.py and none anywhere else (verified by grouping every FAILED line by file). They assert /access redirects, www canonicalisation and Amplify rewrite rules against scripts/provision_legacy_redirects.py - another session's URL-routing convergence, which landed a commit between the two runs. This work cannot have caused them and that is provable: the ONLY tracked modification in the tree is .kiro/steering/META-BETA-REQUEST-EMAIL.md (dirty at baseline, not mine), and this step's entire output is three UNTRACKED Markdown files. A Markdown file cannot change a Python test result. The owned suite re-run at the same moment: 508 passed / 7 xfailed / 0 failed / 0 xpassed. Not fixed, per multi-session rule 1 - and the failing file's own helper (_require_converged_provisioner) says it skips rather than fails against a pre-convergence provisioner, so the owning session already has a mechanism for this state and is the only one who can tell which side is behind. Recorded in handoff §12 with the evidence and the re-measure commands.

xfail INVENTORY UNCHANGED AT 7, AND THEY ARE EXACTLY DECISION 8'S LIST
SEAM-C1 (cart_v2.py:333), SEAM-C2/G6 (the order-payload producer), SEAM-G1 x2 (cart_v2.calculate refuses giftCards), SEAM-G14 (website_checkout.py), SEAM-G7(a) (finalization.py), SEAM-G7(b) (side_effect_guard.KNOWN_EFFECTS). NO do-not-touch FILE WAS MODIFIED. .kiro/steering/META-BETA-REQUEST-EMAIL.md shows ` M` and was dirty at baseline, as FEAT-001, FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 each recorded; `git commit --only` excluded it.
